The data dictionary lists the data each journey records or exchanges, as the [WHO SMART Guidelines DAK](https://smart.who.int/ig-starter-kit/l2_dak.html) does in its component 5. **This demonstrator defines no data model of its own**: it shows how the existing specifications are used, so each data set is a model one of them already publishes. J1 signs the DVC payload of WHO SMART Trust PHW (`DVCMinPreQual`) into the CBOR Web Token of WHO SMART Trust (`CWT`); J2 registers the child with the client record of the WHO Immunization guide (`IMMZC4`, which is also its update of client details); J3 imports each verified dose as that guide's Immunization profile (`IMMZImmunization`); and J4 generates one IHE Verifiable Health Link payload (`VHLPayload`) per QR code.

Each element is named `<model>.<path>` and is listed as its own specification defines it; that specification is the authority, and only the elements the journeys use are shown. "Realised in" says where this guide's profiles and examples carry the element. The elements are read by the [decision-support logic](decision-logic.html) and counted by the [indicators](indicators.html).

The source is `dak/data-dictionary.json`; this page and the code lists are generated from it. Every person and value in the examples is fictional.

### J1 DVCMinPreQual DVC HCERT payload (PreQual)

The minimal Digital Vaccination Certificate payload of WHO SMART Trust PHW, with the vaccine coded by its WHO PreQual product id. J1's birth hospital builds one per dose; J2 reads it unverified on a home visit and J3 reads it again when the clinic verifies it.

- **Logical model:** [DVCMinPreQual](http://smart.who.int/trust-phw/StructureDefinition-DVCMinPreQual.html), canonical `http://smart.who.int/trust-phw/StructureDefinition/DVCMinPreQual`
- **Specification:** [WHO SMART Trust PHW](http://smart.who.int/trust-phw), package `smart.who.int.trust-phw` (0.2.0-litlfred)
- **Recorded or read in:** [J1 Issue the newborn's birth-dose DVCs in Country A](business-processes.html#j1-issue-the-newborns-birth-dose-dvcs-in-country-a): Build one DVCMinPreQual payload per dose (`Task_Payload`); [J2 Discover and refer an unregistered infant in Country B](business-processes.html#j2-discover-and-refer-an-unregistered-infant-in-country-b): Read each DVC unverified (triage) (`Task_Read`); [J3 Verify, import and schedule at the home clinic](business-processes.html#j3-verify-import-and-schedule-at-the-home-clinic): Verify each HCERT against the trust list (`Task_Verify`)
- **Requirements:** [STT-PAY-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-001), [STT-PAY-002](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-002), [STT-PAY-003](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-003), [STT-PAY-005](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-005), [STT-VER-011](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-011)
- **Realised by:** [StructureDefinition TrustDemoTaifafekiPatient](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoTaifafekiPatient.html), [StructureDefinition TrustDemoTaifafekiImmunization](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoTaifafekiImmunization.html), [Patient TrustDemoTaifafekiSomsak](Patient-TrustDemoTaifafekiSomsak.html), [Immunization TrustDemoJ1HepB](Immunization-TrustDemoJ1HepB.html), [Immunization TrustDemoJ1Bcg](Immunization-TrustDemoJ1Bcg.html)

### J1 CWT CBOR Web Token (CWT)

The CBOR Web Token of WHO SMART Trust that carries a DVC payload: the COSE header that names the signing key, the CWT claims and the signature. J1 signs one per dose with the key of Taifafeki; J3 checks each against the trust list.

- **Logical model:** [CWT](http://smart.who.int/trust/StructureDefinition-CWT.html), canonical `http://smart.who.int/trust/StructureDefinition/CWT`
- **Specification:** [WHO SMART Trust](http://smart.who.int/trust), package `smart.who.int.trust` (1.5.0)
- **Recorded or read in:** [J1 Issue the newborn's birth-dose DVCs in Country A](business-processes.html#j1-issue-the-newborns-birth-dose-dvcs-in-country-a): Prepare: CWT claims and the COSE Sig_structure (`Task_Prepare`); Sign the bytes with XXR's DSC key (`Task_Sign`); [J3 Verify, import and schedule at the home clinic](business-processes.html#j3-verify-import-and-schedule-at-the-home-clinic): Verify each HCERT against the trust list (`Task_Verify`); Every DVC verified? (`Gateway_Verified`); Note the failure; decide doses by policy (`Task_Unverified`)
- **Requirements:** [STT-CWT-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-cwt-001), [STT-VER-001](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-001), [STT-VER-006](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-006), [STT-VER-008](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-008)
- **Realised by:** [StructureDefinition TrustDemoOnesaDvcVerification](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoOnesaDvcVerification.html), [Provenance TrustDemoJ3Verification](Provenance-TrustDemoJ3Verification.html)

| Element | Label | Card. | Type | Definition | Binding | Realised in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `CWT.header` | COSE header | 0..1 | BackboneElement | The COSE header (COSEHeader). |  | COSE_Sign1 protected header |
| `CWT.header.1` | Algorithm (alg) | 0..1 | string | The signature algorithm. |  | COSE header alg |
| `CWT.header.4` | Key identifier (kid) | 0..1 | string | Identifies the document signer certificate on the trust list that verifies the DVC (J1: 916ffa567c0f44a2). |  | COSE header kid; TrustDemoOnesaDvcVerification: Provenance.entity.what.display |
| `CWT.payload` | CWT payload | 0..1 | BackboneElement | The CWT claims (CWTPayload). |  | COSE_Sign1 payload |
| `CWT.payload.1` | Issuer (iss) | 0..1 | Coding | The trust-network participant whose key signs the DVC (J1: XXR). |  | CWT claim 1; TrustDemoOnesaDvcVerification: Provenance.entity.what.display |
| `CWT.payload.4` | Expires at (exp) | 0..1 | dateTime | When the DVC stops verifying, where the issuer sets an expiry. |  | CWT claim 4 |
| `CWT.payload.6` | Issued at (iat) | 0..1 | dateTime | When the DVC was signed. |  | CWT claim 6 |
| `CWT.payload.-260` | Health certificate (hcert) | 0..1 | BackboneElement | The hcert claim, which carries the DVC payload (DVCMinPreQual). |  | CWT claim -260 |
| `CWT.signature` | Signature | 0..1 | string | The signature over the Sig_structure, made with the signer's key. |  | COSE_Sign1 signature |
{: .grid }

### J2 IMMZC4 IMMZ.C4 Create client record (= IMMZ.C5.3 Update client details)

The client record of the WHO Immunization DAK, which also serves its IMMZ.C5.3 Update client details activity. J2's community health worker registers the newborn with it and updates the child's details later; J3's dose schedule is computed from its date of birth.

- **Logical model:** [IMMZC4](http://smart.who.int/immunizations/StructureDefinition-IMMZC4.html), canonical `http://smart.who.int/immunizations/StructureDefinition/IMMZC4`
- **Specification:** [WHO Immunization Implementation Guide](http://smart.who.int/immunizations), package `smart.who.int.immunizations` (1.0.0)
- **Recorded or read in:** [J2 Discover and refer an unregistered infant in Country B](business-processes.html#j2-discover-and-refer-an-unregistered-infant-in-country-b): Add the infant; save doses as reported (`Task_Register`); [J3 Verify, import and schedule at the home clinic](business-processes.html#j3-verify-import-and-schedule-at-the-home-clinic): Evaluate the national schedule (`Task_Schedule`)
- **Requirements:** [STT-VER-011](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-011), [STT-PAY-005](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-pay-005)
- **Realised by:** [Questionnaire TrustDemoHouseholdRegistration](Questionnaire-TrustDemoHouseholdRegistration.html), [QuestionnaireResponse TrustDemoJ2Registration](QuestionnaireResponse-TrustDemoJ2Registration.html), [StructureDefinition TrustDemoOnesaRegistration](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoOnesaRegistration.html), [StructureDefinition TrustDemoOnesaPatient](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoOnesaPatient.html)

| Element | Label | Card. | Type | Definition | Binding | Realised in |

### J3 IMMZImmunization IMMZ Immunization

The Immunization profile of the WHO Immunization guide (IMMZ.D Administer vaccine). J2 saves each dose read from a foreign card with it as reported (primarySource false); J3 imports each verified dose with it (primarySource true), adds the national code beside the product code and counts it toward the schedule.

- **Profile:** [IMMZImmunization](http://smart.who.int/immunizations/StructureDefinition-IMMZ.Immunization.html), canonical `http://smart.who.int/immunizations/StructureDefinition/IMMZ.Immunization`
- **Specification:** [WHO Immunization Implementation Guide](http://smart.who.int/immunizations), package `smart.who.int.immunizations` (1.0.0)
- **Recorded or read in:** [J2 Discover and refer an unregistered infant in Country B](business-processes.html#j2-discover-and-refer-an-unregistered-infant-in-country-b): Add the infant; save doses as reported (`Task_Register`); [J3 Verify, import and schedule at the home clinic](business-processes.html#j3-verify-import-and-schedule-at-the-home-clinic): Import the doses as FHIR Immunization resources (`Task_Import`); Add national codes beside foreign ones (`Task_Map`); Evaluate the national schedule (`Task_Schedule`); Give due doses and book the next visit (`Task_Plan`)
- **Requirements:** [STT-VER-006](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-ver-006), [STD-SEM-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-sem-001.json), [STD-SCH-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-sch-001.json)
- **Realised by:** [StructureDefinition TrustDemoOnesaImmunization](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoOnesaImmunization.html), [StructureDefinition TrustDemoOnesaReportedImmunization](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoOnesaReportedImmunization.html), [Immunization TrustDemoJ2HepBReported](Immunization-TrustDemoJ2HepBReported.html), [Immunization TrustDemoJ2BcgReported](Immunization-TrustDemoJ2BcgReported.html), [Immunization TrustDemoJ3HepB](Immunization-TrustDemoJ3HepB.html), [Immunization TrustDemoJ3Bcg](Immunization-TrustDemoJ3Bcg.html)

### J4 VHLPayload VHL Payload

The payload of a Verifiable Health Link (IHE ITI VHL), carried at HCERT claim key 5. J4.0 generates one per QR code, one for each family member; J4.1 reads it from the QR and requests the manifest it points to.

- **Logical model:** [VHLPayload](https://build.fhir.org/ig/IHE/ITI.VHL/branches/jul26/StructureDefinition-VHLPayload.html), canonical `https://profiles.ihe.net/ITI/VHL/StructureDefinition/VHLPayload`
- **Specification:** [IHE ITI Verifiable Health Links (VHL)](https://build.fhir.org/ig/IHE/ITI.VHL/branches/jul26), package `ihe.iti.vhl` (ci build, branch jul26 (not yet released))
- **Recorded or read in:** [J4.0 Issue the family's records to one phone as VHLs](business-processes.html#j40-issue-the-familys-records-to-one-phone-as-vhls): Choose who to share, with a passcode and an expiry (`Task_Request`); Encrypt, publish a passcode manifest (`Task_Share`); Prepare the HCERT carrying the VHL at key 5 (`Task_Prepare`); [J4.1 Read a family member's records at the point of care abroad](business-processes.html#j41-read-a-family-members-records-at-the-point-of-care-abroad): Verify the HCERT and read the VHL at key 5 (`Task_Verify`); Request the manifest (ITI-YY5), signed (`Task_Fetch`); Check passcode, log access, return manifest (`Task_Release`)
- **Requirements:** [STD-ACC-001](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-trust-demo/blob/main/skills/requirements/std-acc-001.json), [STT-VHL-005](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-vhl-005), [STT-VHL-009](https://litlfred.github.io/smart-trust-tools/viewers/requirements.html#stt-vhl-009)
- **Realised by:** [Bundle TrustDemoJ4Ips](Bundle-TrustDemoJ4Ips.html), [Consent TrustDemoJ4Consent](Consent-TrustDemoJ4Consent.html), [StructureDefinition TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess](StructureDefinition-TrustDemoOnesaVhlAccess.html)

| Element | Label | Card. | Type | Definition | Binding | Realised in |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `VHLPayload.url` | Manifest URL | 1..1 | url | The manifest URL, a FHIR search on the List folder that holds this member's documents. |  | the folder of Bundle TrustDemoJ4Ips |
| `VHLPayload.key` | Decryption key | 1..1 | string | The 32-byte key, base64url, that decrypts the documents the manifest returns. |  | not realised in the examples |
| `VHLPayload.exp` | Expires at | 0..1 | decimal | When the link stops working: the end of the period the holder chose. |  | TrustDemoJ4Consent: Consent.provision.period.end |
| `VHLPayload.flag` | Flags | 0..1 | string | L (long-term) and P (a passcode is required); J4's links carry P. |  | the passcode the holder set |
| `VHLPayload.label` | Label | 0..1 | string | A short description of what the link shares, for example the member's name. |  | not realised in the examples |
| `VHLPayload.v` | Version | 0..1 | integer | The protocol version. |  | not realised in the examples |
| `VHLPayload.extension` | Extensions | 0..1 | BackboneElement | Implementation-defined extensions. |  | not realised in the examples |
| `VHLPayload.extension.fhirBaseUrl` | VHL Sharer FHIR base URL | 0..1 | string | Where the receiver performs UDAP discovery before a signed manifest request (ITI-YY5). |  | not realised in the examples |
{: .grid }
